services.desc: Welcome to Escaparium Shawinigan, our newest location bringing the excitement of escape rooms to the Mauricie region. Currently featuring our signature game 'The Family', we offer an immersive escape experience designed for groups of 2 to 6 players. At Escaparium Shawinigan, you'll experience the same high-quality, handcrafted escape rooms that have made us the premier escape room company in Quebec. Each game is carefully designed and built in-house, ensuring attention to detail and an unforgettable adventure. Whether you're a local resident or visiting the beautiful Shawinigan area, our escape room provides the perfect entertainment for families, friends, or team building activities. Book
